channel_declaration.ppi_tail_masking: slots beyond PPI_LEN are set to zero before feature construction

containment_statistic: Stage 2 joins rebuilt X1 per-pair eps_hi values to explicitly labeled per-service detector-error surrogates.

floor_violation_test.deferred_resolution: The X1 upper-side rows are now available and joined; the old missing-join condition no longer holds.
floor_violation_test.object_granularity_statement: A pair is the unordered (service_a, service_b) service pair from X1; because this script emits no pairwise detector, floor_violation uses the explicitly labeled macro-average of the two constituent per-service classification-error rates as a pair-level surrogate.

flow_set.flow_key_definition: table date plus ID; each row is assigned to one side

per_pair_detector_errors.row_definition: one test flow per holdout level, with one column group per detector

deferred_history.previous_reason: Stage 1 had no join from detector measurements to the X1 upper-side values.
deferred_history.resolution: Stage 2 reads upper_recomputed.eps_hi from the rebuilt X1 artifact and computes the floor through eibo.statcore.

preregistration.falsification_rule: an excess of floor violations falsifies either the estimate or the channel model and must be reported
preregistration.pair_object_statement: A pair is the unordered (service_a, service_b) service pair from X1; because this script emits no pairwise detector, floor_violation uses the explicitly labeled macro-average of the two constituent per-service classification-error rates as a pair-level surrogate.
preregistration.restriction_rationale: without the informative-stratum restriction, trivial coverage on well-separated pairs dilutes the check and the test can be passed by saying nothing
preregistration.test_statistic: number of floor violations among informative pairs against a one-sided binomial test at nominal coverage

schema.tail_mask: all slots i >= min(PPI_LEN, k_packets) set to zero
